what: post-commit principal swap (write random bytes into context_user_id_bin of an anchored row) on the real deployment, under the authenticated anchor, scored for renderer misattribution and for HOMEPROV detection
substrate: real (mosquitto + MQTT discovery + shipped motion-light blueprint), three home configurations
oracle: the platform's own logbook EventProcessor (per-room ec_report), identical to E-C/E-D; detection by the shipped monitor/verifier
commitment_note: closure: the monitor commits the renderer closure, including context_user_id_bin, the only column this arm writes

second.what: anchored second-segments inside the run window that no PS trial touched and that fail recomputation

minute.what: anchored minute-segments inside the run window that no PS trial touched and that fail recomputation

detection_method.how: every anchored segment root in the run window recomputed from a consistent snapshot of the final recorder, using the SHIPPED monitor's load()/commit()
detection_method.late_row_test: a violating segment whose row count rose after sealing (delta_n > 0) is late-arriving benign traffic, not a detection of the swap
